bio: Set amidst vineyards, this small house and its modern extension are the HQ of local lad and chef, Jean-Christophe Moutet, former second chef to Jacques Lameloise at Chagny for over a decade. Comfortably seated in a panoramic dining room, complete with a grand piano and glazed wine cellars, Burgundy connoisseurs can sample gutsy, wholesome cuisine in tune with the seasons: wild snails flanked by cauliflower (sauce and sprigs) and smoked bacon; seared scallops, pig’s trotter, Jerusalem artichoke, gravy and truffles....
